aggregation_note: accuracy/brier/logloss/mae values in this artifact file are MACRO averages (mean of per-season fold values), NOT pooled correct/total. See pooled_correct_* fields for exact pooled numerators. ATS and O/U accuracies are genuinely pooled.

ats.method: pooled (weighted by n); pushes excluded from n

backtest_protocol.calibration: IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds='clip'), fit on last 20% (chronological) of each training fold; never on test season
backtest_protocol.folds: one per season 2016-2025; train = all final regular-season games with season < Y; features warmed from 1999
backtest_protocol.leakage_harness: ml.leakage.KickoffLeakageHarness: _data_through < kickoff per row; per-fold max-train-kickoff < min-test-kickoff; truncation-invariance tests in tests/test_ml.py
backtest_protocol.market_lines: nflverse spread_line/total_line (closing, PFR source) used ONLY for ATS/O-U grading; never model inputs
backtest_protocol.retraining: per-season refit inside each fold; no per-week or per-game retraining
backtest_protocol.target: home_win in {1,0}; 1 iff home_score > away_score (ties encoded 0); winner predicted home iff calibrated P(home) >= 0.5

elo_baseline_mnb_nfl_2026_01.formula: P(home)=1/(1+10^(-(elo_diff+35)/400)); elo_diff home-away, K=20, margin multiplier (|m|+3)^0.8/(7.5+0.006|diff|)

ensemble_mnb_nfl_2026_02.catboost_note: no CatBoost code exists anywhere in the repository
ensemble_mnb_nfl_2026_02.ensemble_method: stacking: LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, sklearn defaults) on chronological TimeSeriesSplit(n_splits=3) out-of-fold P(home); margin/total via Ridge(alpha=1.0, positive=True) weights normalized to sum 1
ensemble_mnb_nfl_2026_02.status: challenger - did NOT beat the Elo baseline (accuracy_vs_elo_baseline = -0.0269)
